% A breakable tcolorbox around content of unknown height, with a tikz
% underlay at a node anchor: every group the box opens closes again, so
% the node's saved anchors (\southwest) stay local. A real document hit
% 300 s when they leaked: later pictures read them as unknown operands.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tcolorbox}
\tcbuselibrary{skins,breakable}
\newtcolorbox{sbx}{blanker,breakable,underlay={\fill ([xshift=1pt]frame.south west) -- (frame.north east);}}
\newdimen\uh \uh=\pdfelapsedtime sp
\begin{document}
\begin{sbx}A \rule{1pt}{\uh} b.\end{sbx}
\makeatletter
\ifnum\currentgrouplevel=0 \ifx\southwest\undefined\gdef\AfterBoxGroupsClosed{}\fi\fi
\makeatother
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\end{document}
